value.author: claude-orchestrator
value.text: Orchestrator follow-up from Greptile review on pm-jira#48, applied fleet-wide after checking all 18 READMEs. The Requirements section still advertised a pm-cli floor of 2026.7.5 while peerDependencies now demands >=2026.7.29, which misleads installers and invites strict-peer install failures for versions the docs present as supported. Updated the floor to >=2026.7.29. Only three packages carried a stale requirement floor (pm-gantt-chart, pm-jira, pm-linear); the other pm-cli version references across the fleet are feature-availability notes such as the 2026.7.19 atomic-import and 2026.7.22 merge-reconcile lines, which remain historically accurate and were deliberately left alone.
